chapter: Luck, tricks and the Bourbon Street job
title: Luck cannot be bought; handling money
summary: Speck lost it all to gambling and women; Valentine argues that luck is separate from management and that squandered money does not last.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant
